name: GET /api/leadflow/incidents - open incidents, local and upstream
description:
Unresolved local failure records merged with platform-raised incidents.

MERGED DELIBERATELY, with the counts kept separate. An operator asking "what is on fire" means both, and two screens means one of them goes unwatched — but an unreachable incident service is NAMED rather than letting its absence shrink the list silently.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
